pass_b_english: But by deeper words, Isaiah says: 'I gave Egypt and Ethiopia and Syene as thy exchange; since thou becamest precious before me.' (Isaiah 43:3–4) The exact word concerning this and the rest — if, loving learning in Christ, and wishing already to surpass learning 'through a mirror' and 'in a riddle,' you hasten to him who called — you shall know not yet 'face to face,' as friends of the heavenly Father and Teacher. For friends learn in form, not through riddles — with bare wisdom, apart from voices and words and symbols and types — assailing the nature of intelligibles and beauty of truth. If you believe Paul was 'caught up to the third heaven,' (Hebrews 4:14) 'caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which a man may not speak' (1 Corinthians 13:12) — you shall consistently know that, of the unspeakable words then revealed to Paul — after which he came down from the third heaven — you shall know more and greater straightway, without coming down after knowledge: if, taking up the cross, you follow after Jesus, whom we have as 'great High Priest, passed through the heavens.' (2 Corinthians 12:2–4) And yourselves, not departing from behind him, shall pass through the heavens — surpassing not only earth and earth's mysteries but heavens and theirs. For stored with God are far greater spectacles than these, which no nature in a body — unless first freed from all body — can hold. I am persuaded that what sun and moon and the star-choir saw — and holy angels, whom God made 'spirit' 'and a flame of fire' — ... [transition to ch. XIV damaged; see section 13] (Psalm 104:4).
